name: Cajun Cube Clash 2018

venue.name: East Baton Rouge Independence Park Library
venue.details: The competition will take place in the Meeting Room, which is just past the Courtyard Fountain.

information: There will be a 75 person competitor limit. The registration fee for this competition is  $25. The venue is located in the Meeting Room of the East Baton Rouge Independence Park Library. CAJUN CUBE CLASH 2018 T-SHIRTS  WILL BE INCLUDED IN THE COST OF REGISTATION FOR ALL COMPETITORS! PLEASE INCLUDE YOUR SHIRT SIZE IN THE COMMENTS OF YOUR REGISTRATION!
